# iximiuz-labs_course (Resource)

Manages an iximiuz-labs course.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iximiuz-labs_course" "example" {
  name_prefix = "my-course"
  variant     = "modular"
  sample      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) A name prefix for the course. The API will append a unique suffix to produce the final `name`.
- `sample` (Boolean) Whether to generate sample content for the course.
- `variant` (String) The course variant (`simple` or `modular`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the course was created.
- `name` (String) The course name (slug), assigned by the server.
- `page_url` (String) The course web URL.
- `title` (String) The course display title.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the course was last updated.
